Search an address or click a lot. Lot-level answers cover Philadelphia and Pittsburgh. The rest of the state shows tract and town results.

- **ADU Testing** (MUSA 6950): one lot, three scenarios, a unit you can draw and move. [Open full screen](../#/?view=test){target="_blank"}
- **ADU projecting and analysis** (MUSA 5500): tracts, towns and counties. [Open full screen](../#/?view=project){target="_blank"}
- **Tract explorer** (MUSA 5500): [open](musa5500/figures/tract_explorer.html){target="_blank"}

Not legal advice. Not a zoning determination. Parcel lines are not a survey. Bills are not law.
